page.overview:
What is Twisted Wolf?

Twisted Wolf, also known as The Wolf, is one of the four twisted animatronics and an antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Twisted Ones. It was created by William Afton to hunt down and kill Charlotte Emily.

Twisted Wolf is a misshapen wolflike figure with a sleek snout and usually stooped over. When Charlie first encounters it, she finds it in the middle of shifting forms. Twisted Wolf's normal appearance is a tattered metal framework, partly coated in rubbery translucent skin. Its eyes are stark white bulbs. Twisted Wolf's chest splits open with tooth-like ribs folding outward. When its illusion discs are active, it appears as a groomed and agile figure covered in silver hair. Twisted Wolf has a silver wolf's mane that runs over top of its head and down its back. It also has shining blue eyes, claws, and long, silken ears.

In the official teasers, Twisted Wolf is depicted as in the middle of changing forms. The right side of its body more closely resembles a wolf, being very furry and with its silver mane running over the top of his head and down its back, and the right hand and right foot being smaller. The left side however, is more robotic, with a visible endoskeleton, rubbery translucent skin, a wider left eye socket, and spikes protruding from its left arm.

The wolf is first seen by Charlie in Chapter 8. Clay Burke was in his police car along with Charlie, John, and Jessica, who were all taking a nap. He watches from afar the mounds that were made by the twisted animatronics that the teenagers discovered in a women's backyard, as one of them was housed by Twisted Freddy. Tired of waiting, he decides to go and check on the mounds. This awakens Charlie, and she wakes up John and Jessica so they can accompany her. To their surprise, the mounds were gone. Clay runs back to the car, and Charlie tries to catch up but she suddenly hears a high-pitched scream. She then sees the wolf, who stares at her for a moment, then spasmed alarmingly with his chest splitting open. A woman fell from inside him. The wolf then heads into the woods, disappearing into the dark. Clay approaches from behind Charlie and tries to assist the woman, who was still alive, while John and the others get help.
